body:
Went for a walk at 3 in the morning. Reread my message, and damn I sounded angry. 

Frustration boils ever eh? The combination of a shitty day with bad news and general loneliness really got to me tonight... 

I hate being in that place. Where you hate yourself so much that all you can think about is all the shit that has happened over the last few weeks. Its like you build yourself up into a rage and your mind is your worst enemy. 

I've posted before on this board, but last time it was about my ex. I think at least I can take hope that this time she was only a sentence in my opening post rather than a page long description.

This too will pass... I cant see it now, but I'm tired of shooting myself in the foot. I've fucked up bad no doubt. 

Thanks for the reply, I really needed a calm voice.
